title: Muscle Tone — Spasticity, Rigidity and the Modified Ashworth Scale

hook.en: "Tight" is not a diagnosis. Learn the speed test that separates spasticity from rigidity, how to grade tone with the Modified Ashworth Scale and what the Tardieu angles tell you about treatment.
hook.ur: “Tight” koi tashkhees nahi. Speed test seekhein jo spasticity ko rigidity se alag karta hai, Modified Ashworth Scale se tone ka grade dena aur Tardieu angles treatment ke baare mein kya batate hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll tell spasticity from rigidity by speed, grade tone on the Modified Ashworth Scale and use Tardieu R1 and R2 to decide between a neural and a contracture problem.
goal.ur: End tak aap speed se spasticity ko rigidity se alag karenge, Modified Ashworth Scale par tone grade karenge aur Tardieu R1 aur R2 se tay karenge ke masla neural hai ya contracture.

text.en: **Tone** is the resistance you feel when you move a relaxed limb passively. **Spasticity** is *velocity-dependent*: the faster you move, the more it resists (a catch), then it may give way like a clasp-knife. **Rigidity** is *velocity-independent*: the same resistance at slow and fast speeds, through the whole range, in both directions. **Flaccidity** is no resistance at all. Always move slowly first, then fast — the speed test is the whole trick.
text.ur: **Tone** woh resistance hai jo aap relaxed limb ko passively move karte waqt mehsoos karte hain. **Spasticity** *velocity-dependent* hai: jitna tez move karenge utna zyada resist karegi (catch), phir clasp-knife ki tarah dheeli ho sakti hai. **Rigidity** *velocity-independent* hai: aahista aur tez dono speeds par, poori range mein, dono directions mein ek jaisi resistance. **Flaccidity** mein bilkul resistance nahi. Hamesha pehle aahista, phir tez move karein — speed test hi poora raaz hai.

text.en: Spasticity is a car door with a stiff spring: push it gently and it moves, slam it and it fights back. Rigidity is a door rusted at the hinge: it resists the same at every speed. Flaccid is a door off its hinges.
text.ur: Spasticity sakht spring wala car ka darwaza hai: aahista dhakelo to chalta hai, jhatke se maro to ladta hai. Rigidity hinge par zang lagi hui darwaza hai: har speed par ek jaisi resistance. Flaccid woh darwaza hai jo hinges se utar gaya ho.

intro.en: Watch the elbow moved from full flexion to full extension in about **one second**. Use the **Ashworth grade** buttons (1, 1+, 2, 3, 4) and watch the resistance curve change as the grade rises.
intro.ur: Elbow ko full flexion se full extension tak takriban **ek second** mein move hota dekhein. **Ashworth grade** buttons (1, 1+, 2, 3, 4) use karein aur grade barhne par resistance curve ko badalte dekhein.

rows.en: A slight catch and release, or minimal resistance at the very end of range
rows.ur: Halka catch aur release, ya range ke bilkul end par minimal resistance

rows.en: A catch followed by minimal resistance through less than half of the range
rows.ur: Catch, phir range ke aadhe se kam hissay mein minimal resistance

rows.en: More marked increase through most of the range, but the limb moves easily
rows.ur: Zyada range mein wazeh izafa, lekin limb aasani se move hota hai

rows.en: Considerable increase; passive movement is difficult
The part is rigid in flexion or extension
rows.ur: Hissa flexion ya extension mein rigid

question.en: A patient's elbow resists more the faster you extend it, with a catch at mid-range and then a release. What is this called?
question.ur: Patient ka elbow jitna tez extend karein utna zyada resist karta hai, mid-range mein catch aur phir release. Isay kya kehte hain?

feedback.en: Yes — the catch-and-release that gets stronger with speed is spasticity, an upper motor neuron sign.
feedback.ur: Haan — catch-and-release jo speed ke saath barhta hai spasticity hai, upper motor neuron sign.

feedback.en: Rigidity would feel the same at slow and fast speeds.
feedback.ur: Rigidity aahista aur tez dono par ek jaisi lagti.

feedback.en: Flaccid limbs offer almost no resistance.
feedback.ur: Flaccid limbs mein resistance taqreeban nahi hoti.

intro.en: Here the resistance is **constant and smooth** through flexion and extension, at slow and fast speed — the pipe-bending feeling of Parkinson's disease or drug-induced parkinsonism. Compare it with the Ashworth demo.
intro.ur: Yahan resistance flexion aur extension mein, aahista aur tez speed par **constant aur smooth** hai — Parkinson’s disease ya drug-induced parkinsonism mein pipe mor'ne wala ehsaas. Isay Ashworth demo se compare karein.

intro.en: The resistance gives way in **rhythmic steps like a ratchet**, because a tremor is superimposed on the rigidity. Ask the patient to draw circles with the other hand — this *reinforcement* brings the cogwheeling out.
intro.ur: Resistance **ratchet ki tarah rhythmic steps** mein toot-toot kar milti hai, kyunke rigidity ke upar tremor hota hai. Patient se doosray haath se circles banwayein — yeh *reinforcement* cogwheeling ko nikalta hai.

text.en: **Testing too fast, too slow, or too many times.** The MAS needs the limb moved through its full range in about one second, no more than three repetitions (more repetitions reduce tone). Test in the same position each time (spasticity changes with posture), at a similar time of day and temperature, and never grade an uncomfortable or guarded limb. Do not confuse a **contracture** (a fixed shortening that resists at every speed) with spasticity.
text.ur: **Bohat tez, bohat aahista, ya bohat baar test karna.** MAS mein limb ko poori range mein takriban ek second mein move karna hota hai, teen se zyada repetitions nahi (zyada repetitions tone kam karti hain). Har baar ek hi position mein test karein (spasticity posture ke saath badalti hai), waqt aur mausam ek jaisa rakhein, aur takleef ya guarded limb ko kabhi grade na karein. **Contracture** (fixed shortening jo har speed par resist karti hai) ko spasticity na samjhein.

intro.en: First move the limb **slowly** (V1) to find the full passive range, **R2**. Then move it **fast** (V3) and find the angle of the catch, **R1**. The gap R2 − R1 tells you how much of the limitation is spasticity and how much is contracture.
intro.ur: Pehle limb ko **aahista** (V1) move karke poori passive range, **R2**, dhoondein. Phir **tez** (V3) move karke catch ka angle, **R1**, dhoondein. R2 − R1 ka gap batata hai ke rukawat mein kitna spasticity hai aur kitna contracture.

question.en: A patient has R1 = 40° and R2 = 90° on the Tardieu scale. What does the large gap suggest?
question.ur: Patient ka Tardieu scale par R1 = 40° aur R2 = 90° hai. Bara gap kya batata hai?

text.en: Much of the restriction is dynamic spasticity, so tone management, positioning and stretching can help
text.ur: Rukawat ka zyada hissa dynamic spasticity hai, is liye tone management, positioning aur stretching madad kar sakti hain

feedback.en: Yes — a big R2 − R1 gap means the muscle can lengthen when the stretch is slow; spasticity is the main problem.
feedback.ur: Haan — bara R2 − R1 gap matlab muscle aahista stretch par lamba ho sakta hai; spasticity asal masla hai.

text.en: A fixed contracture needing casting or surgery
text.ur: Fixed contracture jis ko casting ya surgery chahiye

feedback.en: A contracture shows a small gap: R1 and R2 are close together.
feedback.ur: Contracture mein gap chhota hota hai: R1 aur R2 qareeb hotay hain.

feedback.en: Normal muscle has no early catch, so R1 is not found well before R2.
feedback.ur: Normal muscle mein jaldi catch nahi hota, is liye R1 R2 se pehle nahi milta.

text.en: **From finding to treatment.** A large Tardieu gap points to a neural component: positioning, sustained stretch, splinting and (medically) botulinum toxin or oral drugs can help. A small gap with reduced R2 suggests a contracture: serial casting or surgery may be needed. In Parkinsonian rigidity, rhythmic mobilisation, large-amplitude movement (LSVT BIG) and cueing help more than stretch. In every case, link tone to *function*: tone is only a problem if it limits hygiene, positioning, comfort or movement.
text.ur: **Finding se treatment tak.** Bara Tardieu gap neural component ki taraf ishara hai: positioning, sustained stretch, splinting aur (doctor ki taraf se) botulinum toxin ya oral dawaiyan madad kar sakti hain. R2 kam ke saath chhota gap contracture batata hai: serial casting ya surgery chahiye ho sakti hai. Parkinsonian rigidity mein rhythmic mobilisation, large-amplitude movement (LSVT BIG) aur cueing stretch se zyada madad dete hain. Har soorat mein tone ko *function* se jorein: tone tabhi masla hai jab woh hygiene, positioning, aaram ya movement ko rokay.

text.en: The Modified Ashworth Scale is widely used but its reliability is **only moderate** (especially between raters and for the lower limb), and it does not separate neural from non-neural resistance. The Tardieu scale does, and shows better reliability when performed with standard velocities. Neither measures function, so always pair a tone score with a task such as reaching, sit-to-stand or walking.
text.ur: Modified Ashworth Scale kaafi use hoti hai lekin iski reliability **sirf moderate** hai (khaas taur par raters ke beech aur lower limb mein), aur yeh neural ko non-neural resistance se alag nahi karti. Tardieu scale karti hai aur standard velocities par behtar reliability dikhati hai. Koi bhi function ko measure nahi karti, is liye tone score ke saath reaching, sit-to-stand ya walking jaisa task hamesha jorein.

question.en: Why should you not call "stiffness after a stroke" spasticity without testing?
question.ur: Test kiye bagair “stroke ke baad sakhti” ko spasticity kyun nahi kehna chahiye?

answer.en: Because stiffness may be spasticity (neural, velocity-dependent), **contracture** (fixed shortening of muscle and soft tissue), pain-guarding, or oedema. Each needs a different treatment. Move slowly and fast, compare R1 and R2, and look for a fixed end-feel.
answer.ur: Kyunke sakhti spasticity (neural, velocity-dependent), **contracture** (muscle aur soft tissue ki fixed shortening), dard ki guarding ya oedema ho sakti hai. Har ek ka ilaaj alag hai. Aahista aur tez move karein, R1 aur R2 compare karein aur fixed end-feel dhoondein.

question.ur: Kaun si finding **Parkinsonian rigidity** se best match karti hai?

text.en: Uniform resistance at all speeds, with a ratchet-like cogwheel when tremor is present
text.ur: Har speed par ek jaisi resistance, tremor ho to ratchet jaisa cogwheel

feedback.en: Yes — velocity-independent rigidity with cogwheeling is typical of basal ganglia disease.
feedback.ur: Haan — velocity-independent rigidity aur cogwheeling basal ganglia ki bimari ki tipical nishani hai.

text.en: A catch that grows with speed and a release
text.ur: Speed ke saath barhne wala catch aur release

text.en: Almost no resistance and floppy limbs
text.ur: Taqreeban koi resistance nahi aur dheelay limbs

text.en: **Refer urgently** if tone suddenly increases or changes in a person with a spinal cord injury (it can signal pain below the injury, a pressure sore, a bladder infection, or autonomic dysreflexia with a pounding headache and very high blood pressure), or if a new rigid or stiff presentation comes with fever and confusion. Never force a spastic joint through range against pain.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** agar spinal cord injury wale shakhs mein tone achanak barh ya badal jaye (yeh injury ke neeche dard, pressure sore, bladder infection ya autonomic dysreflexia ka ishara ho sakta hai jis mein dhamakay wala sir dard aur bohat zyada blood pressure hota hai), ya nayi rigid ya sakht halat bukhar aur confusion ke saath aaye. Spastic joint ko dard ke khilaf zabardasti range mein na dhakelein.

summary.en: Spasticity is velocity-dependent (catch and release); rigidity is the same at all speeds; move slowly, then fast.
summary.ur: Spasticity velocity-dependent hai (catch aur release); rigidity har speed par ek jaisi; pehle aahista, phir tez move karein.

summary.en: Grade tone with the MAS (0 to 4, move in about 1 second, up to 3 times) and use Tardieu R1 and R2 to separate neural from contracture.
summary.ur: Tone ko MAS (0 se 4, takriban 1 second mein move, 3 baar tak) se grade karein aur Tardieu R1 aur R2 se neural ko contracture se alag karein.

summary.en: Always link tone to function and treat the cause: tone management for spasticity, serial casting for contracture, large-amplitude work for Parkinsonian rigidity.
summary.ur: Tone ko hamesha function se jorein aur wajah ka ilaaj karein: spasticity ke liye tone management, contracture ke liye serial casting, Parkinsonian rigidity ke liye large-amplitude kaam.

front.en: How do you tell spasticity from rigidity?
front.ur: Spasticity ko rigidity se kaise alag karte hain?

back.en: Spasticity depends on speed (more resistance when faster, with a catch); rigidity is the same at slow and fast speeds.
back.ur: Spasticity speed par depend karti hai (tez par zyada resistance, catch ke saath); rigidity aahista aur tez dono par ek jaisi.

back.en: 0 none; 1 slight catch; 1+ catch then minimal resistance (<half range); 2 marked increase but easy movement; 3 considerable increase; 4 rigid.
back.ur: 0 koi nahi; 1 halka catch; 1+ catch phir minimal resistance (aadhi range se kam); 2 wazeh izafa lekin aasan movement; 3 kaafi izafa; 4 rigid.

front.en: What do Tardieu R1 and R2 mean?
front.ur: Tardieu R1 aur R2 ka kya matlab?

back.en: R1 = angle of the catch at fast stretch; R2 = full passive range at slow stretch. A big R2 − R1 gap means spasticity, a small gap means contracture.
back.ur: R1 = tez stretch par catch ka angle; R2 = aahista stretch par poori passive range. Bara R2 − R1 gap spasticity, chhota gap contracture.

back.en: Rigidity with a superimposed tremor, felt as rhythmic ratchet-like give; typical of Parkinson's disease.
back.ur: Rigidity ke upar tremor, rhythmic ratchet jaisi dheel; Parkinson’s disease ki tipical nishani.
